The searches also did not establish the 70%–90% customer share on a matching annual basis. An incomplete or incompatible calculation does not by itself prove that the actual ratio or share was false.
limitations: The $120 billion denominator is retained as the speaker's assumption.
Multiyear commitments and revenue backlogs were not substituted for annual compute spending.
Confirmation of the pipeline input is insufficient to score the full proposition supported.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Assuming a generous $120 billion in annual compute demand and counting the tens of billions of dollars of data centers announced since February's Sightline report, there are over 15 times more data centers being planned than the demand that exists, and 70% to 90% of that demand is from Anthropic and OpenAI's unprofitable services.
conditions: if we assume $120 billion in annual compute demand
taking Sightline's February figures at their word

statement.excerpt: If we assume — and I’m being nice! — that there’s $120 billion in annual compute demand, and take into account that tens of billions of dollars’ worth of data centers have been announced since, this means that there’s over 15 times more data centers being planned than the demand that actually exists, and 70% to 90% of that demand is from Anthropic and OpenAI’s unprofitable services.

from_speaker: tens of billions of dollars’ worth of data centers have been announced since
our_interpretation: Treat $120 billion as a stipulated annual demand estimate, not a forecast antecedent requiring proof that it happened.
The claim concerns the February pipeline plus additional announcements through July 22, 2026.
The plain reading of over 15 times is a comparison of planned service capacity with current demand measured on compatible terms.
Interpret the 70%–90% figure as the two companies' combined share of the stipulated annual compute-demand total, without counting the same spending again at successive suppliers.
Annual demand is an estimated current annual pace; it is not company revenue, financing or the total value of multiyear contracts.
criteria.support_condition: A reconciled project inventory and comparable capacity-demand calculation establish a ratio above 15, while matching annual compute-spending evidence establishes a combined OpenAI and Anthropic share of 70%–90%. The description of their services as unprofitable also requires matching financial evidence.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes a ratio at or below 15, a combined demand share outside 70%–90%, or profitability of the relevant services under an identified financial measure.
